## Checklist

- [ ] One folder under its catalogue with a manifest and a real preview image (not a placeholder).
- [ ] One entry added to that catalogue's `registry.json` (`lastUpdated` in `YYYY-MM-DD`; `official: false` for community items).
- [ ] Tested live in Ryoku, it renders and behaves correctly (see `DEVELOP.md`).
- [ ] `tests/validate-catalogue.sh` passes from the repo root.
- [ ] I own or have permission to submit this content, and it is licensed for redistribution.
- [ ] It does not overwrite user configuration or run privileged commands without clear consent.
